format_boundary: Review views over existing contracts; not a new runtime schema, global registry, or Canonical Store.

step4_prerequisite.accepted_effect_boundary: Reuse the existing scoped Step4 administrative acceptance; this candidate issues no new acceptance, runtime authority or Freeze.

entry_schema_policy: Use the baseline alias fields when a real compatibility mapping is proposed; no parallel runtime registry/schema is introduced here.
observation_limit: Typed inventory is a bounded surface extraction, not a global alias detector. Zero newly issued aliases is not a claim that every historical or external alias has been enumerated.

explicit_dispositions.action: NO_INFERRED_ALIAS_OR_RETIREMENT; exact installed projection/consumer mapping required only if that migration is proposed

explicit_dispositions.case: retired local Memory Engine root path contract
explicit_dispositions.action: HISTORICAL_ONLY_NO_REDIRECT_TO_CURRENT_WRITER; retain pre-cutover tag and original names

explicit_dispositions.case: namespace grouping labels versus program domain IDs
explicit_dispositions.action: NO_IMPLICIT_ALIAS; use exact Step 4 source map/domain references

future_resolution_rule: A new alias must resolve to exactly one typed target in its scope and record reverse lookup. Absent or ambiguous mapping rejects the proposed rename/consumer change, not unrelated source-preserving preparation.
retirement_rule: Retain actual old entry until that specific consumer mapping, accepted compatibility window and rollback evidence exist; never repair historical bytes in place.
